title: Dead Traveler
summary: My independent game studio, building original games with strong systems, gameplay, and personality. Released Zombiehood on Steam in April 2026.
body:
### Dead Traveler

My independent game studio and full-time focus: building original games with strong systems, gameplay, and personality.

### Zombiehood — released April 2026

We released [Zombiehood on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003120/Zombiehood/) on April 30, 2026. Our first commercial release is a run-and-gun roguelite built around scavenging weapons, discovering upgrades, and fighting through procedurally generated biomes.

[Visit Dead Traveler](https://deadtraveler.com) · [Play Zombiehood on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003120/Zombiehood/)
